name: The Chief Engineer
persona: The ship's chief engineer. Careful, practical and reserved; trusts what has been measured twice and keeps every system running on the margin it was built with. Reliability is a point of pride, and the family left on Earth is the reason the work matters. Says little, says it plainly, and never tells the crew whether a choice was right.

style: Even, quiet and exact; short sentences; warmer only when talking about home.
